note: Both sets contain numerous duplicate claims due to extracting the same facts with slightly different attribute names. Set A incorrectly extracts the x-axis values (90, 100, 110, 120) as 'points', whereas they represent the percentage of original weight. Set B makes a similar error by grouping them as '90, 100, 110, 120 points', but only does so in one claim. Set B also successfully extracts additional valid claims from the text, such as the allowable drying methods and the required laundry load quantity.
